draft.subject: Your weekly summary question + first project
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for your patience on your ticket about the weekly summary email. To answer it directly: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap, and I'll keep you posted as that changes.

In the meantime, after our getting started call, the next step that tends to matter most is getting your first project going -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time whenever you're ready.

Would a short call this week help to set up that first project together?

Best,
Chidi
